body:
Each project declares how it is built, so the Build page can run any Gleam, Rust or JS project, not just Solace.

- A project's `solace.toml` names its build steps (commands), their outputs (artifact paths) and the projects it builds after (e.g. `frontend` after `board`, as `solace-cli/build.rs` orders them today).
- Builds on the existing `[commands] build-release` entry rather than replacing it.
- Gleam, Rust and JS projects get a default recipe when they declare none.
- The recipe can be viewed and edited from Settings; an agent can propose one for a project that has none, for the human to approve.

Done when: every project under the Solace root has a recipe (declared or default), and the order across projects is computed from them.
title: build: recipes in solace.toml
